h1: Admin user tools for support and account management
overview: When a customer writes in, your team needs answers quickly. We build an admin area for users: search by name or email, open a profile with plan, status and recent activity, and use safe actions such as sending a reset link, suspending an account, changing a role or resending verification. Every action is logged with the staff member's name, and sensitive details stay hidden from those who do not need them.

faq: Is it safe to let staff view a user's account?
With care, yes. Read-only viewing is logged, hides sensitive items such as payment details and needs an admin role. We recommend clear company rules, and we do not give legal advice.
Never. Passwords are stored as hashes and cannot be read. Staff can only send a reset link, so the customer chooses a new password privately.
Can you add this to the admin area I already have?
Yes. We add a Users section in the same style and keep your current screens. If you have no admin area, our admin dashboard service builds the wider panel.
Does it work with my login service?
Yes for services with an admin API, such as Auth0, Clerk, Firebase and Supabase. We check what your service allows before you order, so the actions are available.
